## Level-up flow

**Trigger:** XP thresholds in `XP_THRESHOLDS` (`worker/src/types/index.ts:175`) — 300/900/2700/6500/14000/23000/34000/48000/64000; max level 10. Worker computes `shouldLevelUp(character)` (`services/character.ts:159`): `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level] && level < 10`. Returned as `canLevelUp` by `POST /api/action` and `POST /api/combat/resolve`. Frontend also pre-computes it (`character-state.service.ts` `checkLevelUp`) but overwrites with the server value.

**UI:** Banner in character sheet + ability picker in console sidebar (`game-console.component.html:19-28`); after combat a system message prompts it.

**Call:** `levelUp(key)` in `game-console.component.ts:183` → `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` (`game-api.service.ts:74`) → **`POST /api/levelup`** (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`). `abilityChoice` ∈ str/dex/con/int/wis/cha; 400 if `!shouldLevelUp`.

**Character changes** (`services/character.ts:133` `levelUp`):
- `level += 1`
- HP gain = roll(class hit die) + CON modifier, added to both `max_hp` and current HP (hit dice: Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6 via `CLASS_HIT_DICE`)
- Chosen ability score **+2** (no cap at 20; AC unchanged)

**After:** flavor text (`generateLevelUpNarrative`, usually fallback per bug B-03), a `[Level Up]` system log row, DM history turn; frontend calls `setCharacter`, `setCanLevelUp(false)`, shows system message, updates campaign slot level. One level granted per call — multiple pending levels require multiple calls.
